page_placeholder: This page arrives in a later release.
home_search_title: What do you want to watch?
home_search_body: Search for videos, channels and playlists, or paste a YouTube link.
empty_subscriptions_body: Subscribe on a channel page, or import your subscriptions from YouTube, NewPipe, Invidious or Piped.
empty_playlists_body: Save videos to a playlist to watch later, or share it by link.
empty_history_body: Videos you watch are listed here, so you can pick up where you left off.
history_paused_body: Videos you watch now are not added, and no resume points are saved.
history_clear_body: Every video is removed from your history, along with where you left off. This cannot be undone.
empty_sign_in_hint: Sign in to keep subscriptions, playlists and history on this server.
error_load_body: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
settings_appearance_hint: Follows your system until you pick a theme.
settings_language_hint: Used for menus, dates and numbers.
auth_login_subtitle: Subscriptions, playlists and history are kept on this server.
auth_register_subtitle: Your data stays on this server. No YouTube account needed.
auth_error_username_format: Use 3 to 32 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores.
search_prompt_body: Type in the search box, or paste a YouTube link to open it directly.
search_empty_body: Check the spelling or try fewer, broader words.
search_error_body: The server could not get results from YouTube. Try again in a moment.
channel_not_found_body: This channel does not exist or is no longer available.
channel_no_videos_body: This channel has not published any videos.
channel_search_prompt_body: Find a video of this channel by its title or topic.
channel_no_shorts_body: This channel has not published any shorts.
channel_no_live_body: This channel has not streamed yet.
channel_no_playlists_body: This channel has no public playlists.
auth_error_account_disabled: This account is disabled. Contact the administrator of this instance.
auth_error_too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
auth_error_registration_disabled: Registration is disabled on this instance.
auth_local_disabled: This instance only offers single sign-on.
auth_registration_closed_body: New accounts cannot be created on this instance. Ask its administrator for access.
watch_no_video_body: Open a video from search, a channel or your subscriptions.
watch_live_body: Oxistream plays recorded videos for now. Come back once the stream has ended.
watch_error_not_found_body: Check the link. The video may have been removed.
watch_error_bad_request_title: This is not a video link
watch_error_bad_request_body: Video IDs are 11 letters, digits, dashes or underscores.
watch_error_unavailable_body: YouTube does not offer this video for playback.
watch_error_age_restricted_body: YouTube only plays it for signed-in accounts, and Oxistream never signs in to YouTube.
watch_error_private_body: Only people the uploader invited can watch it.
watch_error_deleted_body: The uploader or YouTube took it down.
watch_error_geoblocked_title: Not available in this server's region
watch_error_geoblocked_body: YouTube blocks this video in the country this instance connects from.
watch_error_members_only_title: This video is for channel members
watch_error_members_only_body: It needs a paid channel membership, which Oxistream cannot use.
watch_error_premium_body: Premium videos only play for paying, signed-in accounts.
watch_error_paid_title: This video has to be bought
watch_error_paid_body: Paid and copy-protected videos do not play in Oxistream.
watch_error_offline_stream_body: The livestream is offline and no recording is available yet.
watch_error_no_streams_body: YouTube sent no streams Oxistream can play. Try again later.
watch_error_rate_limited_title: YouTube is slowing this server down
watch_error_rate_limited_body: Too many requests left this instance. Wait a few minutes and try again.
watch_error_upstream_body: The request to YouTube failed. Try again in a moment.
auth_oidc_error_disabled: Single sign-on is not set up on this instance.
auth_oidc_error_unavailable: The sign-in provider cannot be reached right now. Try again in a moment.
auth_oidc_error_denied: Sign-in was cancelled at the provider.
auth_oidc_error_failed: Single sign-on did not complete. Start again from this page.
feed_fetching_body: Their latest videos show up here in a moment.
feed_no_videos_body: None of your channels has published a video so far.
import_export_description: Move your subscriptions between Oxistream and other apps.
import_export_sign_in_body: Imported subscriptions are stored with your account.
import_hint: Exports from YouTube Takeout (subscriptions.csv), NewPipe, Invidious (JSON or OPML) and Piped. The format is detected automatically.
import_skipped_hint: Only channels with a /channel/UC… link can be imported. Handles, custom URLs and other services are skipped.
import_pending_hint: New channels appear in your feed within the next few minutes.
import_error_unrecognized: This file is not a supported subscription export, or it is damaged.
import_error_too_large: The file is larger than 5 MB.
import_error_signed_out: Your session ended. Sign in again and retry.
import_error_offline: The server cannot be reached. Check your connection and retry.
import_error_failed: The import did not complete. Try again in a moment.
export_hint: Download your subscriptions to use them in another app.
export_newpipe_body: Also imports into Piped, LibreTube and Invidious.
playlist_visibility_private_hint: Only you can see this playlist.
playlist_visibility_unlisted_hint: Anyone with the link can watch, even without an account.
playlist_save_empty: You have no playlists yet. Create one to save this video.
playlist_save_sign_in: Sign in to save videos to playlists
playlist_mix_title: Mixes can't be opened as playlists
playlist_mix_body: YouTube puts mixes together for each viewer, so they have no fixed list of videos.
playlist_unavailable_body: It was deleted, made private, or the link is wrong.
playlist_none_body: Open a playlist from your library or a shared link.
playlist_not_found_body: It was deleted, made private by its owner, or the link is wrong.
playlist_not_found_sign_in: If this is your private playlist, sign in to open it.
playlist_share_prompt: Copy this link to share the playlist:
playlist_private_hint: Make the playlist unlisted to share it by link.
playlist_delete_body: The playlist is removed for good, also for anyone you shared it with. The videos stay on YouTube.
playlist_empty_body: Save videos from their watch page with the Save button.
playlist_reorder_hint: Drag to reorder, or use the arrow keys, Home and End.
shorts_discover_empty_body: YouTube had no shorts to suggest. Try again in a moment.
shorts_subscriptions_empty_body: Your channels have not published any shorts yet.
playlist_copy_error: The playlist could not be copied. Try again.
playlist_copy_hint: Copies the videos into a playlist of your own that you can edit.
playlist_follow_hint: Keeps the playlist in your library and tracks new videos.
playlist_own_empty: No playlists of your own yet.
like_hint: Saved on this instance only, never sent to YouTube
liked_empty_body: Like videos and shorts to collect them here.
liked_sign_in: Sign in to see the videos you liked.
liked_error_load: Liked videos could not be loaded
liked_private_hint: Only you can see this list. Likes stay on this instance and are never sent to YouTube.
block_notice_body: Its videos, shorts and playlists stay out of search, related videos and trending. Subscribing unblocks it, too.
blocked_description: Blocked channels stay out of search, related videos and trending.
blocked_empty_body: Block a channel from its page or a video's menu to stop seeing it.
blocked_sign_in_body: Sign in to block channels and manage them here.
sponsorblock_description: Skip sponsors and other segments marked by the SponsorBlock community. This server looks them up anonymously, so SponsorBlock never learns which video you watch.
sponsorblock_saved_locally: Saved in this browser. Sign in to keep them with your account.
sponsorblock_highlight_hint: Marks the part most viewers look for and offers to jump there.
sponsorblock_full_video_hint: Shows a label when the whole video is about a product or service.
sponsorblock_category_selfpromo_hint: Unpaid promotion: merch, donations, other channels.
sponsorblock_category_interaction_hint: Reminders to like, subscribe or follow.
sponsorblock_category_preview_hint: Previews and recaps of other episodes.
sponsorblock_category_hook_hint: Teasers and greetings before the actual content.
sponsorblock_category_music_offtopic_hin: Talking and skits in music videos.
sponsorblock_category_filler_hint: Tangents and jokes not needed for the main content.
settings_history_hint: Pause or clear what you watched.
settings_account_hint: Your password, or deleting your account.
settings_sponsorblock_hint: Skip sponsors and other marked segments.
settings_save_failed: Could not save the change. Try again.
settings_guest_body: Codec and quality preferences, your home page, history and account settings need an account. The rest works without one.
settings_playback_hint: Applies on this account across all devices.
settings_audio_language_hint: Auto-dubbed tracks only play when you pick them in the player.
settings_codec_hint: Automatic lets the player pick. A custom order is used where your device can decode it.
settings_max_quality_hint: Higher qualities are never loaded, which saves data.
settings_default_quality_hint: Automatic adapts to your connection. A fixed quality stays until you change it in the player.
settings_home_hint: Choose which rows the home page shows, and in which order.
settings_home_shown_hint: Drag or use the arrows to reorder.
settings_home_empty: No rows are shown. Turn one on below.
settings_history_clear_hint: Removes every watched video and resume point.
settings_password_hint: Other devices are signed out after the change.
settings_password_changed: Password changed. Other devices were signed out.
settings_delete_hint: Removes your account with its subscriptions, playlists, history and settings.
settings_delete_body: Your subscriptions, playlists, history and settings are deleted, and shared playlist links stop working. This cannot be undone.
settings_delete_last_admin: You are the last admin. Make another user an admin before deleting your account.
home_empty_body: All rows are hidden. Choose some in the settings.
together_intro: Watch in sync with friends. Anyone with a room's link can join, control playback and add videos, no account needed.
together_start_hint: Start a room with this video
together_start_failed: The room could not be opened. Try again.
together_sign_in: Sign in to open rooms. Anyone with a room's link can join without an account.
together_queue_empty: Nothing up next. Add a video by link, ID or search.
together_add_placeholder: Paste a link or ID, or search
together_share_prompt: Copy this link to invite others:
together_close_body: Everyone in it is disconnected and the link stops working.
together_close_failed: The room could not be closed. Try again.
together_closed_body: Rooms close when the host ends them, or a day after everyone left.
together_kicked_title: You were removed from this room
together_kicked_body: The host removed you, so you cannot join this room again.
together_not_found_body: The link may be wrong, or the room was closed or expired.
together_full_body: Try again when someone has left.
together_join_body: Pick a name the others will see.
together_join_sign_in: Sign in to join with your account
together_login_required: Sign in to join this room.
together_error_invalid: Enter a YouTube link or video ID.
together_error_rate: Slow down a little and try again.
together_error_generic: That did not work. Try again.
together_no_video_body: Add a video to the queue to start watching.
together_history_hint: Videos watched in rooms are not added to your history.
